sentences.text: Staphylococcus is a bacterial genus whose members include the coagulase-negative species Staphylococcus epidermidis, a member of the human skin microbiota.
Coagulase-negative staphylococci compete with invading bacteria directly, through antimicrobial molecules and signalling antagonism, and by priming skin immunity.
A review describes Staphylococcus aureus, also in this genus, as an opportunistic pathogen reported to be responsible for the majority of bacterial skin infections.

Published work reports that Staphylococcus epidermidis is the commonest cause of implant-associated infection, forms biofilms, and that commensal staphylococci can shift towards opportunistic behaviour in skin dysbiosis.
